creator: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) driving the owner's live Krita through the krita_mcp bridge
sourceMethod: 2560x1440 sRGB RGBA/8 Krita document at 2 px per world unit (1280x720 world). Built entirely by bedroom_study.py: per-object groups (base, inherit-alpha clipped soft shade and warm light, line), a gentle one-point perspective (vanishing point 680,60; depth 800 u), pass-through light and paper-grain groups, and hidden annotation layers. The whole document was rebuilt from the final script before saving. Blender was not needed.

layoutSource.method: Read-only import by layout2py.mts into bedroom_layout_data.py (interactable bounds, floor band, CHILD_START, MOM_SPOT, SLEEPER_HEAD, camera targets).

placedInputs.use: Existing Boy candidate cutout, scaled uniformly to 200 u with soles at CHILD_START; pixels not edited
Placed at the fluffed pose centre (170, 463)
Hidden alternate layer at the same centre

visualReferences: app-momee/assets/references/concepts/morning-routine-storyboard.png, morning-routine-gameplay.png, feature-concepts.png (bedroom furniture, bedding and light; viewed only)
momPlaceholder: A flat, dashed-edge silhouette labelled 'MOM — PLACEHOLDER (not art)', 290 u, about 3.1 heads, at MOM_SPOT. It is not character art.
exportMethod: Krita exportImage (opaque PNG) with layer-group visibility set per render; the @1x room-only and annotated renders were downsampled from 2560x1440 with `sips -z 720 1280`.
storageNote: The KRA is 39,139,356 bytes, above the README's proposed 10 MiB ordinary-Git threshold. No Momee LFS rule exists. Owner storage decision required before any commit.
generativeModelUsed: No image-generation model in this milestone. The placed Boy candidate was generated earlier (M0.3c.1, ChatGPT Image Generation; see its generation-log.json).
reviewNotes: Composition and calibration study only. Not a room background, atlas or production asset.
